cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is China Eastern 102, destination Beijing, 4800 meters maintaining, estimating DOGAR 05, information Foxtrot, now contact Beijing Approach.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 China Eastern 102，目的地北京，保持 4800 米，预计 DOGAR 05，通播 Foxtrot，现在联系北京进近。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, 4800 metres maintaining, estimating DOGAR 05, information F.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，保持 4800 米，预计 DOGAR 05，通播 F。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, Beijing Approach, DOGAR 03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，北京进近，DOGAR 03 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 01，保持 4800 米。
cards.referenceText: DOGAR 03 arrival, expect ILS approach runway 01, maintain 4800 metres, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: DOGAR 03 进场，预计 ILS 进近跑道 01，保持 4800 米，CES5102。

cards.audioText: B: Flight attendants reported that a loud noise is coming from the backward right of the cabin, report this to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: B：乘务员报告客舱后右方传来很大噪音，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, we have a loud noise coming from the cabin.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，我们客舱有很大噪音。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, descend to and maintain 2100 meters on QNH 1012.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，QNH 1012 下降并保持 2100 米。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 2100 metres on QNH 1012, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: QNH 1012 下降并保持 2100 米，CES5102。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, can you describe the sound in more detail?
B: It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，你能更详细描述声音吗？
B：似乎是外部气流声或轻微失压问题。
cards.referenceText: It seems to be an outside air noise or a slight depressurization problem, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 似乎是外部气流声或轻微失压问题，CES5102。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, roger.
B: The engineers advised that it may be a problem with the door seal. They suggested you reduce speed to minimum, report to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，收到。
B：工程师建议可能是门封问题。他们建议你减速到最小，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, maybe a problem with the door seal. The engineers suggested we reduce speed to minimum.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，可能是门封问题。工程师建议我们减速到最小。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, affirm, do you require emergency services on arrival?
B: You have 3 passengers injured during emergency descent, so you will need medical service on arrival, require priority lending.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，肯定，抵达时你需要应急服务吗？
B：你有 3 名旅客在紧急下降中受伤，所以抵达时需要医疗服务，并请求优先落地。
cards.referenceText: We have 3 injured persons during emergency descent, require ambulance on arrival, request priority landing, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们有 3 名人员在紧急下降中受伤，抵达时需要救护车，请求优先落地，CES5102。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, roger, you are number 1, doctor and ambulance will be ready on arrival.
B: Request change runway 36R to save time.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，收到，你是第 1 架，医生和救护车将在抵达时准备好。
B：请求改用跑道 36R 以节省时间。
cards.referenceText: Request runway change to 36R to save time, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求改用跑道 36R 以节省时间，CES5102。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, roger, turn left heading 300, radar vector for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，收到，左转航向 300，雷达引导着陆。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, the weather is deteriorating, say intention.
B: Tell the controller you want to continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，天气正在恶化，说明意图。
B：告诉管制员你想继续进近。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, descend to and maintain 900 meters, turn right heading 330, report established on localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，下降并保持 900 米，右转航向 330，报告建立航向道。
cards.referenceText: Descend to and maintain 900 metres, turn right heading 330, report established on the localizer, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降并保持 900 米，右转航向 330，报告建立航向道，CES5102。

cards.audioText: B: Report established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: B：报告已建立跑道 36R 五边 5 海里航向道。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, CES5102, established on localizer 5 miles final runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京进近，CES5102，已建立跑道 36R 五边 5 海里航向道。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, continue approach and contact Beijing Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，继续进近，联系北京塔台118.1。

cards.audioText: B: Report to Tower that you have established ILS.
cards.audioTextZh: B：向塔台报告你已建立 ILS。

cards.audioText:
C: China Eastern 102, Beijing Tower, expect low visibility for your arrival, say intention.
B: You want to try landing.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：China Eastern 102，北京塔台，预计你抵达时低能见度，说明意图。
B：你想尝试着陆。
cards.referenceText: Roger, I want to try landing, CES5102.

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, continue approach, report outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，继续进近，报告外指点标。
cards.referenceText: Continue approach, report outer marker, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 继续进近，报告外指点标，CES5102。

cards.audioText: C: China Eastern 102, cleared to land runway 36R, surface wind 160, 7 meters per second, report vacated.
cards.audioTextZh: C：China Eastern 102，跑道 36R 可以落地，地面风 160，7 米/秒，报告脱离。
cards.referenceText: Cleared to land runway 36R, report vacated, CES5102.
cards.referenceTextZh: 跑道 36R 可以落地，报告脱离，CES5102。
